topic: Paying only the minimum on a $5,000 credit card at 24% APR takes over 20 years and roughly doubles what you owe
title: Why Minimum Payments Can Take 20+ Years
description:
Paying only the minimum on a $5,000 credit card balance is a trap designed to keep you in debt for decades. Here's the math that shows how you can end up paying nearly double.

#personalfinance #creditcards #debt #interest #moneytips
